run_webrtc_server: run the Action Engine WebRTC server with configurable host and signalling server settings
register_actions: register echo, gemini, memory, text-to-image, OCR, and SAM actions into the ActionRegistry
setup_action_engine: configure global Action Engine settings for automatic deserialization and read chunk handling
configure_turn_servers: set up WebRTC TURN server credentials for the signalling server connection
set_signalling_headers: set API key and timed peer token headers on the WebRTC server for authentication
